decisions.scenario: Finding a cheap Spanish restaurant and asking for its address

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you find me a cheap Spanish restaurant?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: La Raza is a cheap Spanish restaurant in the centre part of town.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you give me the address, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The address is 4–6 Rose Crescent.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Which area is it in?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: La Raza is in the centre part of town.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You’re welcome. Enjoy your meal!
